verdict.rationale: Requesty documents an OpenAI-compatible router: you change only the base_url to reach hundreds of models. Its docs also claim consistent cross-provider behavior, with structured outputs that behave the same regardless of provider and a single web-search tool definition translated to each provider's format. A probe of llms.txt confirms the product describes itself as a unified LLM gateway. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of cross-provider consistency, and a reconciled model count (docs cite both 300+ and 600+).

support.subject: As a developer, I can call many model providers through one consistent API

citations.quote: Access 600+ models through one API with intelligent routing, real-time analytics and centralized governance.
If you're already using the OpenAI SDK, point it at Requesty and you're done. No SDK changes, no new client to learn.
One API, consistent behavior, regardless of the underlying provider.
Pass a single tool definition and Requesty translates it to the right provider format automatically.
Requesty is a unified LLM gateway and OpenAI-compatible API for 300+ AI models
